# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [INVARIANTS.md](../INVARIANTS.md) before making changes. They are the authoritative repository guidance for all coding assistants.

Use [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md) for package responsibilities and [docs/testing.md](../docs/testing.md) for verification commands and tool versions.

For relevant changes, follow the focused skills linked from AGENTS.md in [`.agents/skills`](../.agents/skills). Keep shared rules in AGENTS.md and INVARIANTS.md; this file serves as the Copilot entry point.
